From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finbank.it>

Date: 2027-04-25 13:12:00 +0000
Subject: FinBank pilot: onboarding safeguards matrix & DPIA artifacts

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the pilot looks promising. Procurement asked me to follow up on a few items we need to complete our internal onboarding checklist for the EU pilot. Can you provide the following by May 10?

- A technical mapping that addresses GDPR Art. 28/30 obligations (who processes what, categories of data, subprocessor list and locations).
- A short DPIA summary focused on the pilot scope (risk mitigations for profiling/automated decisions, retention limits, export safeguards).
- Evidence of cross-border safeguards (SCCs or equivalent, encryption in transit+at rest, key management notes).
- Confirmation of audit/access rights and sample SOC2/processing logs evidence or timeline to provide.

We may need to run a short legal review; if there are particular clauses we should expect in the DPA (transfer mechanisms, subprocessor notification cadence, audit windows), please flag them so our legal and procurement teams know what to expect.

Appreciate a quick acknowledgement and an ETA.

Best,
Elena
Procurement – FinBank S.p.A.
